item.title: Browns star Myles Garrett stopped for speeding for at least the ninth time
item.description: It must be true that football players start to slow down when they hit their 30s — even the best of them. Browns star defensive end Myles Garrett, who turned 30 on Dec. 29, was stopped at 1:35 a.m. on Feb. 21 in Wayne County for allegedly driving 94 mph in a 70 mph zone on Interstate 70. Garrett was driving a green 2024 Porsche. Seven months earlier, when he was 29, he was stopped for driving 100 mph in a 60 mph zone. item.title: Cleveland State men’s season ends in 90-61 loss to Wright State in Horizon League tournament
item.description: The Cleveland State men’s basketball team’s season ended in a 90-61 loss to top-seeded Wright State on March 4 in a Horizon League tournament game in Fairborn. Wright State took the lead with 2:44 left in the first half and did not trail again. Wright State extended its lead to 65-42 during the second half, fueled by a 17-3 scoring run. item.title: John Mobley Jr. scores 28 points for Ohio State in 94-62 win over Penn State
item.description: UNIVERSITY PARK, Pa. — John Mobley Jr. scored 28 points and Bruce Thornton added 18 in Ohio State’s 94-62 win over Penn State on March 4. Three other Buckeye scorers were in double digits — Devin Royal and Amare Bynum both finished with 14 and Christoph Tilly with 10. Ohio State (19-11, 11-8 Big Ten) never trailed, scoring the first points of the game and extending their lead with a 13-0 run in the first half to double digits. item.title: With 100 days to go, World Cup faces new challenges with Iran war and Mexico violence
item.description: By GRAHAM DUNBAR GENEVA — With 100 days to go until the World Cup, the Iran war has added a new layer of complexity to the tournament co-hosted by the United States, Mexico and Canada.
